this is what i mean when i say that for us the basques our diaspora is actually a huge deal unlike some other european ethnicities which not only want nothing to do with emphatically do not embrace theirs but even actively retaliate against them pretty contemptuously for embracing their heritage ive made several posts in the past about how us the basques are actually massively embracing of our diaspora highlighting the fact that the basque government holds every year a very formal major institutional ceremony for the international basque diaspora day on september 8 im arguably even part of the diaspora myself given the fact that although both of my parents were born raised in the basque country i wasnt born have never actually lived there myself but not really given the fact that i was born have always lived in spain i literally never see the term employed to describe people like me which makes sense living at just a 7hour drive away from the basque country ive been to it countless times throughout my whole life since as far back as i can remember traveling there at least twice every year for both the christmas holidays the summer holidays in order to visit my whole extended family so i probably have spent way more time there than the vast majority of those living in the actual diaspora at the other side of the atlantic lol but yeah ive just come across this article that was published last july on eldiarioes by the very man who since the last basque election on april 2024 has been the president lehendakari of the basque country imanol pradales himself i think i couldnt have asked for a better encapsulation of just to what extent our diaspora is actually a huge deal for us than this article which once again was published by the literal current basque president last july lol like take a look at this in 1995 the first world congress of basque communities was held in vitoriagasteiz the differences between the fourteen countries that sent delegates were considerable but curiously what they had in common was more important than what distinguished them comments from interviews showed similar responses from fifthgeneration uruguayan emigrants firstgeneration australians and secondgeneration belgians we are basques who live far from our land but that doesnt make us any less basque the quote comes from the book comparative basque diaspora by gloria totoricagena born in boise idaho usa in 1961 for centuries we ventured out into the world crossing seas and mountains in search of new opportunities and a better life whether due to primogeniture economic necessity or fleeing war and repression but beyond audacity and nonconformity there is one trait that characterizes the basque presence abroad the unwavering will to maintain our collective identity and the capacity to build community those who had already settled offered support to newcomers who needed it most because no one could be left homeless they bought plots in cemeteries so that everyone could have a dignified burial they established basque centers and other basque spaces to meet share and keep their culture and customs alive funding them collectively and through solidarity they knew how to integrate earning the respect of the society that welcomed them maintaining their roots and remaining true to themselves they avoided what seemed an inexorable fate as a minority people and culture being assimilated into the melting pot the history of the basque community in america and specifically in boise exemplifies this perfectly most of those who arrived there in the 19th century worked as shepherds enduring months of isolation and extreme temperatures sleeping in small wagons subsisting on a basic diet and protecting their flocks from coyotes and wolves they were able to prosper from scratch preserve their heritage and leave a legacy today basque is spoken and taught in boise basque culture is studied at the university there are basquelanguage schools ikastolas and summer camps udalekus people dance listen to our music sing bertsos improvised basque verses play mus a card game and enjoy our cuisine in a few days jaialdi the main festival of our diaspora worldwide will be celebrated there this eighth edition takes on special significance because ten years have passed since the last onethe one five years ago couldnt be held due to the pandemicand because of the current global situation thousands upon thousands of basques from all five continents will gather again to reaffirm and celebrate that we belong to one people and we want to build our future in freedom democracy peace and justice together with the other nations with whom we share these values without feeling superior to anyone in times of polarization and pessimism we will joyfully and enthusiastically renew the bonds of identity emotion and culture that our ancestors so carefully preserved in the face of hardship and distance we will celebrate and build community unapologetically reclaiming the value of folklore in its broadest sense all of this makes jaialdi a truly unique celebration that attracts worldwide attention it is no wonder that national geographic recently highlighted it as one of the best events to travel to this year the basque governments visit to the united states has a clear purpose to continue advancing the implementation of the euskadi globala strategy which we presented in january in addition to participating in jaialdi we will hold various meetings with university representatives politicians and members of the diaspora furthermore continuing our objective of strengthening transatlantic relations which took us to new york and washington dc in march we will strengthen collaboration with key institutional representatives in idaho and explore new opportunities for joint projects in the economic cultural political and knowledge sectors the success of the basque country depends on continuing to grow in the international arena identifying and seizing all the opportunities it offers as we have done throughout history it depends on enriching and deepening our existing international relationships and forging new alliances and ties that add value in every area the key then and now lies in the human and relational factor in people and this is where the 21stcentury diaspora comes into play whose role we must revitalize because we need more than ever the support and insights of an active connected and dynamic global basque community to continue growing as a nation and improving our wellbeing from our european base i rest my case

navigating demisexuality after emotional abuse marriage and selfexpression hi everyone i wanted to share my story as a demisexual and get perspective from others who might relate im a 26yearold male and i grew up in an emotionally abusive household as well as in three emotionally abusive churches because of this i was barely allowed to have friendships with girls until i started dating my first romantic partner at age 21 that first relationship became my marriage and my first kiss was on my wedding day unfortunately that marriage was also emotionally abusiveit was professionally diagnosed as such by a counsellorand im currently divorcing i also only learned a few weeks ago that im demisexual i thought i was just strange or always just misunderstood other people because i only ever dated one person and married her i dont have other romantic experiences and im unsure how my demisexuality fits into my life now im honestly not sure i want another romantic relationship in the future and its hard to know whether my orientation should even play a role in my life at this point on top of all this im exploring being more feminine and soft in my expressionbasically exploring being a femboybut not through hormones or surgery its more about movement aesthetics clothing and posture and its part of my process of caring for myself and expressing tenderness after years of neglect and trauma ive also cut off the people who coerced me into my previous lifestyle im sharing this because i sometimes feel isolated navigating all of thisdemisexuality delayed and limited romantic experiences recovering from abuse and exploring gender expression id love to hear from anyone whos been through similar paths how do you approach building connections safely how do you reconcile selfexpression with demisexuality any advice perspective or even just encouragement would mean a lot thanks for reading and for this community being a space to feel seen

understanding bullet proof glass for defense applications in a world where security concerns are no longer limited to military zones transparent protection has become a critical component of modern architecture transportation and defense systems from embassies and government facilities to armored vehicles and secure commercial spaces advanced protective glazing plays a silent but essential role yet many buyers engineers and decisionmakers still use terms like bullet resistant and bullet proof interchangeably without fully understanding the technical regulatory and manufacturing distinctions between them these differences are not merely semantic they directly affect performance expectations compliance cost and longterm reliability understanding how manufacturers approach these categories helps organizations choose solutions that align with realworld threat scenarios rather than marketing language understanding the language of ballistic protection the terms used to describe ballistic glass often create confusion because they suggest absolute outcomes in practice no transparent material is entirely immune to all ballistic threats bullet resistant glass is designed to withstand specific calibers velocities and impact energies defined by recognized testing standards bullet proof glass despite its common usage does not imply invincibility but rather resistance to higher threat levels under controlled conditions manufacturers and certifying bodies therefore rely on precise classifications rather than generic claims these classifications determine layer composition thickness weight and performance behavior under repeated impact for buyers understanding this terminology is the first step toward aligning operational risk assessments with realistic protective capabilities how bullet resistant glass is engineered the engineering process behind bullet resistant glazing focuses on energy absorption and controlled failure and working with an experienced bullet resistant glass manufacturer ensures that material composition lamination accuracy and ballistic ratings are aligned with realworld threat requirements manufacturers build these systems using laminated glass structures combined with polymer interlayers that disperse kinetic energy across multiple layers in applications where transparency and weight balance are critical such as security checkpoints or civilian vehicles manufacturers prioritize optical clarity and manageable thickness a professional bullet resistant glass manufacturer designs each configuration around specific ballistic ratings environmental exposure and installation constraints the goal is not only to stop projectiles but also to minimize spall cracking patterns and postimpact hazards these products are often optimized for mediumthreat environments where repeated impacts are unlikely but protection must remain predictable performance expectations and certification standards certification plays a central role in how manufacturers validate ballistic performance independent testing laboratories evaluate glass systems against standardized protocols that simulate real ballistic threats these tests measure penetration resistance backface deformation and structural integrity after impact independent research has examined ballistic glass behavior and testing methodologies in detail with a peerreviewed study available here as a technical reference manufacturers design their production processes to meet or exceed these benchmarks ensuring consistency across batches for procurement teams certifications provide a measurable baseline that replaces subjective claims with verified data without such validation even visually identical products may perform very differently under stress when bullet proof glass becomes necessary higherrisk environments demand materials engineered for extreme scenarios including military diplomatic and armored transport applications which is why selecting a proven bullet proof glass manufacturer is critical for meeting elevated ballistic and operational standards a specialized bullet proof glass manufacturer develops systems capable of withstanding highercaliber ammunition and multiple impacts in close proximity these products often integrate thicker laminates advanced polycarbonate layers and proprietary bonding techniques that prevent catastrophic failure weight becomes a major design challenge especially in vehicles and aircraft where every additional kilogram affects performance and fuel efficiency manufacturers in this segment invest heavily in research to balance protection with mobility recognizing that overengineering can be just as problematic as underprotection in operational contexts manufacturing precision and quality control the difference between reliable protection and structural failure often lies in manufacturing discipline ballistic glass production requires strict environmental control precision cutting and flawless lamination processes even microscopic imperfections can compromise performance under impact leading manufacturers implement multistage inspections optical testing and destructive sampling to maintain consistency quality control is not limited to the finished product it begins with raw material selection and continues through curing bonding and edge finishing for buyers evaluating a manufacturers production methodology is just as important as reviewing test certificates because consistent performance depends on repeatable manufacturing excellence matching protection levels to realworld use one of the most common procurement mistakes is selecting the highest available protection level without assessing actual risk exposure overspecified glass increases costs weight and installation complexity while offering no practical benefit in lowthreat environments conversely underspecification exposes occupants and assets to unacceptable risk manufacturers typically work with clients to assess threat models environmental conditions and regulatory requirements before recommending solutions this consultative approach ensures that protection levels match operational realities rather than assumptions in many civilian and commercial settings welldesigned bullet resistant systems provide sufficient security without the drawbacks associated with heavier ballistic configurations installation integration and longterm performance even the most advanced ballistic glass can fail if improperly installed manufacturers design systems to work within specific framing anchoring and support conditions improper integration can create stress points that reduce ballistic performance or cause delamination over time longterm durability also depends on resistance to uv exposure temperature fluctuations and moisture ingress reputable manufacturers provide detailed installation guidelines and often collaborate with architects and engineers during project planning this holistic approach ensures that ballistic protection remains effective throughout the products service life rather than degrading after installation future trends in ballistic glass manufacturing innovation continues to reshape the ballistic glass industry as manufacturers explore lighter composites improved energydissipation materials and smarter layering techniques research into nanomaterials and hybrid polymers aims to reduce thickness while maintaining or improving protection levels sustainability is also becoming a priority with manufacturers seeking processes that reduce waste and energy consumption as threats evolve and applications diversify ballistic glass manufacturing will increasingly focus on adaptability rather than brute strength alone buyers who understand these trends can make procurement decisions that remain viable for years rather than becoming obsolete as technology advances final considerations for buyers and specifiers choosing between bullet resistant and bullet proof glass is ultimately a strategic decision grounded in risk assessment regulatory compliance and operational context understanding how manufacturers design test and validate these products empowers buyers to move beyond marketing language and focus on measurable performance transparent protection is a longterm investment in safety and resilience and selecting the right manufacturing partner ensures that this investment delivers reliable results when it matters most by aligning protection levels with realworld needs and verified standards organizations can achieve security that is both effective and intelligently engineered

the legacy of sncipt reviving assams ancient bark manuscripts through traditional wisdom and modern science in the verdant hills and riverine plains of assam a northeastern state of india known for its biodiversity and cultural richness lies a hidden treasure trove of knowledge etched on the bark of trees sncipt manuscripts crafted from the resilient bark of the snc tree aquilaria malaccensis have served as the medium for preserving assams literary religious historical and scientific heritage for over a millennium these handmade folios often adorned with vibrant pigments and sealed with natural varnishes represent a unique fusion of indigenous craftsmanship and environmental adaptation from the early medieval era to the early 20th century they chronicled everything from epic tales and devotional hymns to medical treatises and astronomical observations however as modernity encroaches and traditional practices fade many of these manuscripts are succumbing to the ravages of time humidity fungi and insects this article explores the intricate process of restoring and conserving sncipt manuscripts in ordinary rural settings where sophisticated museum technologies are unavailable by blending ancient assamese techniques with contemporary scientific insights we can ensure these cultural artifacts endure for generations the story of sncipt begins with the snc tree itself a species endemic to assam and prized not only for its bark but also for agarwood a fragrant resin used in perfumes and incense worldwide the tree thrives in the regions subtropical climate for exploring space include advancing scientific research national prestige uniting different nations ensuring the future survival of humanity and developing military and strategic advantages against systems on earth and interfere with and even damage satellites and space probes numerous spacecraft dedicated to observing the sun beginning with the apollo telescope mount have been launched and the first flyby was the 1961 venera 1 though the 1962 mariner 2 was the first flyby to successfully return data mariner 2 has been followed by several other flybys by multiple space agencies often as using radar to pierce the obscuring atmosphere earth space exploration has been used as a tool to understand earth as a celestial object orbital missions can provide data for earth that can be difficult or impossible to obtain from a purely groundbased point of reference for example the existence of the van allen radiation belts was unknown until their discovery by the united states first artificial satellite explorer 1 these belts contain radiation trapped by earths magnetic fields which currently renders construction of habitable space stations above 1000 km impractical following this early unexpected discovery a large number of earth observation satellites have been deployed specifically to explore earth from a spacebased perspective these satellites have significantly
